# Learnings and mistakes

No structural facts are generated for this page; the store has no concept of a mistake, only of records, decisions and handovers. Everything here is written by hand.

## Notes (human, preserved verbatim on regeneration)

<!-- bm-human:begin -->
SIX LESSONS, all paid for tonight. The two that are written up in full are
docs/mistakes/M24 and M25 in the repository; the rest are here.

1. THE RECEIVED DIAGNOSIS OF A FINDING WAS WRONG, and acting on it would have
   destroyed something. Finding H9 in the plan said the sibling's fence registry
   had rotted and the fix was to clear 35 stale July lines. It has not rotted:
   tools/sbe_score.py:459 tests for the substring "agent" in any bullet, so a
   stall definition, an integration note and a line naming a branch called
   worktree-agent-a387 all count as writer claims. Clearing them would have
   deleted real prose from a state file. Full write-up: docs/mistakes/M24.

2. A DONE-CHECK PASSED FOR THE WRONG REASON, and the orchestrator wrote it. It
   asserted only that both parsers returned a non-empty problem. The two
   mirrored parsers do not share a vocabulary (one names checks:, the other
   gates:), so one had refused the fixture for the wrong key entirely and said
   nothing about the thing under test. Full write-up: docs/mistakes/M25.

3. pgrep ON A SESSION ID IS NOT A LIVENESS TEST. It returned 0 for two sessions
   that were demonstrably alive, because both had just sent messages. A test
   that returns zero for everything makes a live session read as dead, and it
   was about to be cited as evidence for clearing another session's claims.
   Liveness came from ListAgents plus asking the peers directly.

4. TWO CLAIM REGISTRIES GOVERN ONE TREE AND NEITHER SEES THE OTHER. The fence
   hook reads STATE.md and allowed a write the .sbe task registry refused; the
   .sbe authority guard refused an edit to STATE.md that the fence hook allowed.
   One line of code needed four refusals from three registries to land.

5. BOTH REGISTRIES ARE GITIGNORED (.gitignore:3 for STATE.md, :69 for .sbe/), so
   tonight's claim cleanup fixes THIS MACHINE ONLY. A fresh clone starts with
   whatever its own registries hold, and the substring matcher ships to
   everybody. Do not read the cleanup as a repository fix.

6. A TRACKED WRITE INVALIDATED A PEER SESSION'S BATTERY, and nothing anywhere
   announced that a battery was running. A board refresh at 19:16 landed 18
   minutes into another session's baseline capture in this repository. That
   session killed the run and re-ran in an isolated snapshot tree. Discovered
   only because a battery happened to be on this session's own critical path.
